cards.notes:
- The study combines operator-mediated single-condition co-writing, interviews, a survey, edit-log analysis, and staged public performances. `study_design` permits one value; coded `single_condition_usability`, which loses the mixed-method and production-evaluation structure.
- The observation schedule is heterogeneous: most participants had one session, one had a next-day follow-up, and one completed five sessions over two months. `observation_horizon` permits one value; coded the dominant `single_session`, which loses the two repeated-use cases.
- The paper jointly contributes a working artifact and an empirical practitioner study. `contribution_type` permits one applicable block; coded `empirical`, which leaves the artifact demonstration and availability fields unrepresented.
